responsibility: Defines the public surface of the solver inspection subsystem by re-exporting proof-tree inspection types and connecting the internal proof-tree builder with the external analysis API.
same_name_distinction: Among the `solve/*/mod.rs` files, this one is only the proof-tree inspection surface: it re-exports inspection types and connects internal build/analyse modules. It differs by not participating in goal evaluation, candidate assembly, or `NormalizesTo`/projection solving logic at all.
